description: As someone who has dedicated my life to serving and protecting others, I’m asking for your vote because I believe my experience can make a difference in our community. Serving as a Lieutenant Commander in the NYPD taught me a lot about leadership, accountability, and the power of a committed team. Now, I want to bring those values to Albany to fight for what’s right for Assembly District 11. title: Why I'm Asking for Your Vote
